page.notes: Decorative flourishes (⌣) before "Assurgunt", "Multa" and "relicto me" and after "va-" are printer's ornaments, not text; they are not transcribed. "Judæaq;" is a doubtful reading of the printed "Iudaaq;". The reading "istáne" keeps the accent as printed. The signature "Ii" is followed by a mark read as "5" and is uncertain. A stray slash in the right margin is not text and is left out.
